info.name: SAMB Rekonsiliasi AR API
info.description:
The REST API the web app calls (`/api/v1`). Guide: docs/api.md (every endpoint and payload) and docs/testing.md (how to test the whole workflow).

1. Set `baseUrl` (the API, default http://localhost:8002) and `by` (your name: it signs every decision).
2. Run **1 · Look around**: read-only. Each request fills the variables the next one needs (`batch`, `page`, `sor`, …), so run them in order the first time.
3. **3 · See the errors** shows the error payloads; nothing is written.
4. **2 · Do the work** changes data: read each request's description first. Use it on a test stack.

No login yet: `by` is a name, as typed.

item.name: 1 · Look around (read only)

request.description: The counts the top bar shows: orders that need a person (`needs_you`), pages whose type is unsure (`unsure_left`), the teacher's line, today's date.
`{bad: [...], n}`: the services that don't answer, out of `n`. Takes a moment: it probes each one.
Every word the screens show for a stored value: document types, statuses, check names, field names, reasons.
What waits for a person over every scan (`todo`), and the recent scans with their orders by status.

exec: try { const v = (() => { const j = pm.response.json(); return j.todo.need.batch || (j.scans[0] || {}).id; })(); if (!pm.collectionVariables.get("batch") && v !== undefined && v !== null && v !== "") pm.collectionVariables.set("batch", String(v)); } catch (e) {}

request.description: Recent uploads, newest first. Sets `batch` (if empty) to the newest.

exec: try { const v = (() => { const j = pm.response.json(); return (j.scans[0] || {}).id; })(); if (!pm.collectionVariables.get("batch") && v !== undefined && v !== null && v !== "") pm.collectionVariables.set("batch", String(v)); } catch (e) {}

item.name: One scan: its pages and orders

request.description: One scan: its status (received → splitting → split → queued → reading → read), every page with its type and flags, its orders by status. Sets `page` to its first page with a known type, and `thumbKey`.

exec: try { const v = (() => { const j = pm.response.json(); return (j.pages.find(p => p.doc_type) || j.pages[0] || {}).page_no; })(); if (v !== undefined && v !== null && v !== "") pm.collectionVariables.set("page", String(v)); } catch (e) {}

try { const v = (() => { const j = pm.response.json(); return (j.pages[0] || {}).thumb_upright_path || (j.pages[0] || {}).thumb_path; })(); if (v !== undefined && v !== null && v !== "") pm.collectionVariables.set("thumbKey", String(v)); } catch (e) {}

item.name: One page: its fields and where each sits

request.description: One page. `fix` (once the page is read) has its fields with the value read, where it sits on the paper (`box`: ymin,xmin,ymax,xmax on 0-1000) and what backed it (`verdict`, `by`), its table rows, and the words a person can click. Sets `field` to its first field.

exec: try { const v = (() => { const j = pm.response.json(); return ((j.fix || {}).fields || [])[0] && j.fix.fields[0].name; })(); if (v !== undefined && v !== null && v !== "") pm.collectionVariables.set("field", String(v)); } catch (e) {}

item.name: What a region of the page holds

request.description: The words Tesseract read in a box marked on the paper, and a suggested value.

item.name: Key check: does Satellite know this number?

request.description: Before a person saves an SOR or PO number: does Satellite have an order with it? A warning, never a refusal.
What a correction is doing now: kept as a lesson, the teacher writing a tip, tested, switched on. `final: true` when nothing more will happen by itself.

item.name: Jenis halaman: the next unsure page

request.description: The next page of the scan whose type the system couldn't decide (`page` null when none is left), its neighbours, and the choices. Sets `labelPage`.

exec: try { const v = (() => { const j = pm.response.json(); return j.page; })(); if (v !== undefined && v !== null && v !== "") pm.collectionVariables.set("labelPage", String(v)); } catch (e) {}

item.name: Berkas per SOR: orders and held documents

request.description: The scan's orders with their documents and how each joined, the documents held because their number isn't sure (`view.held`, each with `confirm.field`), and pages in no order yet. Sets `heldPage`, `heldField`, `heldValue` from the first held document.

exec: try { const v = (() => { const j = pm.response.json(); return ((j.view || {}).held || [])[0] && j.view.held[0].page_from; })(); if (v !== undefined && v !== null && v !== "") pm.collectionVariables.set("heldPage", String(v)); } catch (e) {}

try { const v = (() => { const j = pm.response.json(); return ((j.view || {}).held || [])[0] && (j.view.held[0].confirm || {}).field; })(); if (v !== undefined && v !== null && v !== "") pm.collectionVariables.set("heldField", String(v)); } catch (e) {}

try { const v = (() => { const j = pm.response.json(); return ((j.view || {}).held || [])[0] && (j.view.held[0].confirm || {}).value; })(); if (v !== undefined && v !== null && v !== "") pm.collectionVariables.set("heldValue", String(v)); } catch (e) {}

request.description: The scan's orders, the ones that need a person first, each with its status and short `issues`. Sets `sor` to the first that needs a person.

exec: try { const v = (() => { const j = pm.response.json(); return (j.rows.find(r => r.status === 'needs_review') || j.rows[0] || {}).sor_no; })(); if (v !== undefined && v !== null && v !== "") pm.collectionVariables.set("sor", String(v)); } catch (e) {}

item.name: One order: what is left to decide

request.description: Everything one order's review needs. `open_items` is what a person must decide (see docs/api.md for how to answer each kind); `can_approve` and `left` say whether it can be approved. Sets `checkKey`/`checkPrint` from the first difference that can be accepted, and `chain`/`chainName` from the customer's calibration.

exec: try { const v = (() => { const j = pm.response.json(); return (j.open_items.find(i => i.kind === 'check' && i.accept) || {}).key; })(); if (v !== undefined && v !== null && v !== "") pm.collectionVariables.set("checkKey", String(v)); } catch (e) {}

try { const v = (() => { const j = pm.response.json(); return (j.open_items.find(i => i.kind === 'check' && i.accept) || {}).print; })(); if (v !== undefined && v !== null && v !== "") pm.collectionVariables.set("checkPrint", String(v)); } catch (e) {}

try { const v = (() => { const j = pm.response.json(); return (j.calibration || {}).chain; })(); if (v !== undefined && v !== null && v !== "") pm.collectionVariables.set("chain", String(v)); } catch (e) {}

try { const v = (() => { const j = pm.response.json(); return (j.calibration || {}).name; })(); if (v !== undefined && v !== null && v !== "") pm.collectionVariables.set("chainName", String(v)); } catch (e) {}

request.description: Every order published to Satellite, newest first. Sets `publishedSor`.

exec: try { const v = (() => { const j = pm.response.json(); return (j.rows[0] || {}).sor_no; })(); if (v !== undefined && v !== null && v !== "") pm.collectionVariables.set("publishedSor", String(v)); } catch (e) {}

item.name: One published order, as Satellite stores it

request.description: Each document's values beside its scan pages (where each sits, what backed it), and the database rows exactly as stored (`tables`).
A page image by its storage key (here the first page's thumbnail).
The PDF written to Satellite for one SOR.
Every service's health, the tables, the AI models' usage, and the scheduler's jobs (`jobs`: when each last ran and what it did).

item.description: Every read, in the order of the work. Safe on any stack.

item.name: 2 · Do the work (writes to the database)

request.description: Choose a PDF in Body → form-data → `file`. Answers 201 `{batch_id}` and sets `batch`. The scan is recorded at once (status `received`) and put on q.intake; the intake worker splits it and the page workers read each page (this uses the AI OCR's quota). The same file again answers 409 with the earlier scan. **Writes to the database.**

exec: try { const v = (() => { const j = pm.response.json(); return j.batch_id || (j.dup || {}).id; })(); if (v !== undefined && v !== null && v !== "") pm.collectionVariables.set("batch", String(v)); } catch (e) {}

request.description: Labels a page whose type is unsure (`labelPage`, from "Jenis halaman"). `label`: FP, TTG, PO, SJ, FPJ, PEL, CONTINUATION or OTHER. The page then resumes reading. **Writes to the database.**

Confirms the number (SOR or PO) of a document held out of every order (`heldPage`/`heldField`/`heldValue`, from "Berkas per SOR"). `value` is the number as printed: check it on the page first. **Writes to the database.**

item.name: Correct a value on a page

request.description: A correction made on the page viewer: `field` (a header field, or `lines[<row key>].<column>`), `value` as printed (or "(not printed)"), and where it was marked (`region`, optional). The page is checked again and the correction kept as a lesson. **Writes to the database.**

item.name: Confirm or correct a value on an order

request.description: Answers a page card or a fix of an open item ("One order"): `page`, `field` and `value` as printed. **Writes to the database.**

item.name: Pair a customer's row with an SO line

request.description: Says which line of SAMB's order (`lines[].line_no` in "One order") a PO/receipt row is, or `"none"` with a `note` from `none_reasons`. `row` is the row's index on the page, from 0. **Writes to the database.**

Accepts an open check with a reason from `accept_reasons` (`checkKey`/`checkPrint`, from "One order"). It holds only while the check says exactly what it said (`input_print`). **Writes to the database.**

The customer's rounding allowance in rupiah (one of `calibration.steps`), or what its receipts print after a rejection (`receipt_shows`: received / ordered). Every order of the customer is checked again. **Writes to the database.**
Approves the order once nothing is left; answers 409 `{error: "not yet", left: [...]}` otherwise. It regroups the scan first. **Writes to the database.**
What Periksa order sends once a browser shows it. Answers 204. **Writes to the database.**
Writes every finished order of the scan (auto_ok or reviewed) to Satellite's tables, with one PDF per SOR. Answers `{result: [SOR, ...]}` and sets `publishedSor`. **Writes to Satellite's tables.**

exec: try { const v = (() => { const j = pm.response.json(); return (j.result || [])[0]; })(); if (v !== undefined && v !== null && v !== "") pm.collectionVariables.set("publishedSor", String(v)); } catch (e) {}

item.description: A person's decisions, in the order of the work. Each one changes data: use a test stack.

item.name: 3 · See the errors (nothing is written)
